why: Guth and Maynard (May 2024) proved a new zero-density theorem improving the bound N(sigma,T) <= T^(30(1-sigma)/13+o(1)) in the critical range, the first improvement on Ingham's 1940 exponent, and Tao-Trudgian-Yang (Jan 2025, arXiv:2501.16779) further improved zero density exponents; both move the density hypothesis's own quantity even though the hypothesis remains unresolved.
